name: InterContinental Phu Quoc Long Beach Resort
insider_take: Vietnam's emerald island paradise where pristine beaches meet luxury hospitality on the Gulf of Thailand.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on Long Beach, Phu Quoc's most famous stretch of sand known for its powdery white shores and spectacular sunsets. The island is Vietnam's largest, famous for its fish sauce production and black pepper plantations. Phu Quoc was once a hidden gem known only to backpackers, but has transformed into a luxury destination while maintaining its unspoiled natural beauty.
pro_tip: Visit the nearby Sao Beach (Starfish Beach) early morning for the clearest waters and best chance to spot starfish in their natural habitat.
dont_miss: Take the world's longest non-stop three-rope cable car to Hon Thom Island, explore the vibrant Dinh Cau Night Market for fresh seafood, and witness the famous Long Beach sunset - consistently ranked among Asia's most beautiful. The island's pepper farms offer fascinating tours showcasing Vietnam's premium spice production.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Long Beach with pristine white sand
Expansive luxury resort with multiple pools and world-class spa facilities
Diverse dining options featuring international and Vietnamese cuisine
Exceptional service standards with personalized guest attention
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
